name: language-region-section
title: Language and region section
description: Language, country, time zone and formats in one card, with a live sample line showing the date, time and number exactly as they will read.
docs: value is the saved setting; the draft lives inside until Save, and a new value passed back replaces it. The preview is formatted with Intl from the draft, always with a time zone, at a fixed moment (sampleDate, a date or an ISO string) so server and browser render the same text. languages are written in their own names; timeZones are IANA ids, grouped by their offset at that moment; locale is the language the country names are shown in.
